title: Ship View Manifest
description: Metadata for a view under .ship/views/<name>/. Loaded by the daemon on request; drives shell rail display, SSE event subscriptions, bundle pack injection, and view-as-app plumbing.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference. Set to this schema's $id so editors offer validation + autocomplete.

name.description: View identifier. Must match the containing directory name. Lowercase kebab-case.

type.description: `html` — Jinja-rendered view under /api/v/<name> (the dominant pattern). `component` — standalone web-component bundle served at /api/view/<name>/bundle.

description.description: Human-readable summary. Surfaced in /api/views, editor tooltips, and docs.

title.description: Page <title> override. Defaults to the view name humanized.

element.description: For `type: component` only — custom element tag name (defaults to `ship-<name>-view`).

entry.description: For `type: component` only — override the default `index.js` entrypoint.

claims.description: Capability tags the view advertises. Metadata today; future permission layer may gate loading based on declared claims.

rail.description: Shell rail + launcher display metadata. View identity only — pin state and ordering are user preferences (stored under `shell.rail.pinned` in /api/settings, not per-view).

label.description: Short human label (e.g. `Dashboard`, `Agents`). Falls back to a humanized view name when omitted.

icon.description: Icon name (rendered as `<sui-icon>`). Falls back to `app-window`.

packs.description: Heavy JS bundles the view needs at render time. Closed enum at v1: only `editor`, `terminal`, and `git` are accepted. The daemon's runtime manifest loader (apps/shipd/src/views/packs.rs) is the source of truth — unknown names are rejected at load time with an error naming the manifest path and offending value, and the lint rule `pkg-stale-pack-declaration` catches them at author time. Pack extensibility for third-party authors is a Phase B concern; do not introduce new pack names without updating this enum, the runtime KNOWN_PACKS constant, the pack→bundle map, and the deck-bundler's targets (the bundler lives in the sui repo post-carve; the targets module is `crates/deck/deck-bundler/src/targets.rs`).

items.description: Closed enum — see the parent description.

theme.description: Publisher-authored theme preference. Only honored when the user's `shell.theme.respect_publisher` setting is `true`; otherwise the shell-wide user theme applies everywhere.

prefers.description: Which light/dark mode the view was designed for. `auto` defers to the user's mode; `light`/`dark` force that mode for this view only.

events.description: Kernel event namespaces this view subscribes to for live re-renders. Prefix-match — `job.` fires on every `job.created`, `job.failed`, etc. Empty string subscribes to everything. Routed SSE at /api/sse/<name> re-renders the view when any subscribed event fires.

data.description: Legacy declaration consumed by generic_sse.rs for views still on the pre-framework context-injection pathway (canvas, overview, setup). File-routed views on the ship.* SDK pull data inline and should omit this block.

oneOf.description: Inject the full collection catalog + active collection schema + items into the render context.
Inject only the named collection schemas.

items.description: Collection id — or the literal `$collection` placeholder — to load items for.
